title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Agent 365 Business Analytics experience
description: Agent 365 Business Analytics brings AI spend, usage, and value together in one place, helping leaders understand where AI investment is going, what value it’s delivering, and where to invest next. Explore cost across services, models, agents, and users, understand the business use cases AI supports and the value it creates, and forecast future spend to make more informed investment decisions.
